from argparse import Namespace
from pathlib import Path
import importlib
from finish_blockc_centerline_sweep import load_model, MODEL_SOURCE_SHA256, sha, write
load_model(Namespace(model_source=Path('/model'), banks_dir=Path('/ref')))
loaded={}
for name,digest in MODEL_SOURCE_SHA256.items():
 module=importlib.import_module(name[:-3].replace('/','.'))
 path=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
 assert path == Path('/model/src')/name,(name,str(path))
 assert sha(path)==digest,name
 loaded[name]={'path':str(path),'sha256':sha(path)}
write(Path('/run/INDEPENDENT_MODEL_IMPORT_CHECK.json'),{'status':'PASS','modules':loaded})
print('PASS: four pinned modules execute from /model/src')
